design_archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Rugged Tactical Industrial)
theme: Dark Theme (Deep Obsidian / Industrial Slate / High-Contrast Amber Gold / Safety Warning Orange)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold uppercase tracking-normal text-slate-100
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400

design_principles: Work-glove friendly ergonomics: Touch targets minimum 48px to 64px height with tactile pressed states
One-handed highway operation: Primary action triggers positioned within easy thumb reach at the bottom on mobile
Zero jargon, high readability: Clear status badges (ACTIVE, EXPIRING SOON, EXPIRED), plain English labels for non-technical drivers
Weigh Station Mode instant clarity: Ultra high-contrast screen showing DOT#, MC#, Insurance status, IFTA badge, and Rig axle capacities in single high-impact view
Role-segmented UX: Seamless Username + 4-digit PIN role switching (Owner/Admin sees company overview & financials; Driver sees assigned rig, current trip, weigh station screen, document vault)
Rugged tactile styling: 1px subtle industrial metallic borders, dark obsidian card surfaces, amber indicator highlights, clear data density

layout_and_spacing.mobile_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#0F1115] text-slate-100 pb-24 shadow-2xl relative font-sans border-x border-slate-800/60
layout_and_spacing.desktop_shell: min-h-screen bg-[#0A0C0E] py-0 md:py-6 flex items-center justify-center

components_guidelines.login: Username and 4-digit numeric keypad/PIN selector for fast role switching (Owner vs Driver)
components_guidelines.navigation: Sticky bottom action bar on mobile with prominent Weigh Station Mode quick-tap button
components_guidelines.weigh_station_mode: Full-screen overlay/mode with max brightness contrast, massive DOT & MC numbers, green active badge, emergency call/verify button
components_guidelines.rig_profile_card: Includes Truck (e.g. Ram 3500 Cummins Dually) + Trailer (e.g. 40ft Big Tex Gooseneck) specs: Empty Wt, Axle Wts, GVWR, GCWR, max payload capacity
components_guidelines.document_vault: Tabs for DOT, MC, Insurance, IFTA, Medical Card, Permits. Visual badge indicators for active (green), expiring in 30 days (amber warning banner), expired (red banner)
components_guidelines.dashboard_guided_flow: One-screen guided 'Next Action' card (e.g., 'Pre-trip checklist pending', '1 document expiring soon', 'Weigh station ahead ready')

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Build strictly mobile-first design with high-contrast, work-glove-friendly button sizes (min-h-[52px]).
Implement Simple Username + PIN authentication supporting two roles: 'Owner/Admin' and 'Driver/Employee'.
Owner role sees full dashboard including financials, all rigs, full doc vault, driver assignments.
Driver role sees assigned rig specs, current active trip, Weigh Station Mode, and Document Vault without financial figures.
Weigh Station Mode must be a zero-latency one-tap full screen view displaying USDOT#, MC#, Insurance status, IFTA badge, and Truck+Trailer Axle Wt limits clearly.
Use Lucide icons and Sonner toasts for clear visual feedback.
Use Shadcn components customized with dark tactical styling (slate-900 backgrounds, amber-500 borders/accents).
